title: cortusa pekinensis
intro: Cortusa pekinensis, commonly known as the Chinese toad-flax, is a plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cortusa pekinensis include expectorant and anti-tussive properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs and respiratory conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
